introduction: In the tension leading up to the final match of the World Mobile Legend competition, Kay, a pro player from the ONIC team, remembers his journey to this point. At the time, he was still in high school: Kay and his 2 best friends, Ido and Aurelio, promised to be pro-players together. However, Kay's plummeting school grades make her mother threaten: raise her grades or be transferred to Arabia to live with her and Kay's father. Afraid of losing her gaming world in the village, Kay tries to improve her grades with the help of Amanda, the smartest student in the class, while continuing to participate in gaming competitions. Unfortunately, Ido begins to have trouble working with Kay, who is unfocused. Aurelio was also hampered by family affairs. Their friendship finally breaks down when Ido decides to kick Kay out of the team. Driven by anger and ambition, Kay sacrifices his closest people one by one to enter major competitions in order to become a pro-player, including Aurelio. Eventually, he lost everyone he loved, was expelled from school, and prepared to go to Arabia to live with his parents. At this lowest point, Kay begins to repair her relationship with her best friend and family. Fate began to side with Kay. He received an offer to become a pro-player. But ambition no longer dominates him. He only wants to join the pro-team if his parents agree. A few years later, Kay was a pro-player who would meet in the final of the world competition with Ido, his best friend and rival.
